name: Submit to Shadow

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would die.

---
In a final gambit, you fill yourself with umbral energy in a gruesome display of shadowy tentacle that disquiets all but the hardiest foes. You remain conscious and regain 6d8 healing Hit Points. Each enemy creature that can see you must succeed at a Will save save against your spell DC or be Frightened 2; this is a fear and visual effect.
